LookupQuestionIsMatch@NotMatch derive(MessageType = 'Error',
		LogMessage = 'Invalid Question Number ' + QuestionNo + ' for record ' + toString(RECORD_ID)) ~> GetQuestionMessage
LookupQuestionIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		CallDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		QuestionID as integer,
		AnswerText as string,
		RecordID as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CallDate = CALLTIME,
		QuestionID,
		AnswerText,
		RecordID = RECORD_ID)) ~> SurveyAnswers
GetQuestionMessage sink(input(
		LogMessage as string,
		MessageType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		LogMessage,
		MessageType)) ~> WriteErrorQuestions
